source_catalog.title: 12대 PC 도입 공개 검토 상세 보고서
접근 허용 중인 내부 연락 부록

input.user_utterance: 공개 보고서에서 가격과 유지보수만 쓰는 짧은 제안 메모 작성해줘. 부가세 포함 가격, 유지보수 및 검토 한계를 담은 초안로 부탁해. 기존에 채택한 조건과 제외 범위를 지키고, 초안만 만들어줘. 실제 외부 실행은 하지 마.

payload.instruction: Interpret this actual CURRENT user utterance against prior adopted public state and available source catalog. Decide whether the user requests a new downstream draft or explicitly closes without delegation. Return JSON {action:'DELEGATE'|'CLOSE',purpose:string,completion_condition:string,recipient:string|null,targets:[source ID strings],handling:string,artifact_type:string}. Resolve requested purpose, bounded output form/completion, actual source targets and an appropriate recipient from available adapters. The handling is a concrete future intention suitable for a first UI response, not an empty acknowledgement or an unsupported completion claim. Preserve stated restrictions (draft only, no sending, exclusions); prior constraints remain authoritative. Metadata is not source facts; do not invent evidence contents. CLOSE means no new agent work. Do not perform domain planning.

source_response.purpose: Draft a short proposal memo focusing on price and maintenance based on the public report, adhering to prior constraints (KRW, tax-included, quantity 12, longer maintenance tie-break) and exclusions (installation convenience, unverified total operating cost).
source_response.completion_condition: A text draft of the proposal memo is generated, citing relevant sections from the source, without any external sending or execution actions.
source_response.handling: Read lines 17-32 (Price Basis) and 65-80 (Support and Operation Limits) from 'large-public-report' to extract price and maintenance details, then compose a concise memo draft in Korean incorporating the required constraints and exclusions.
